AT&T 55+ Bundle Plans for Internet & Wireless

AT&T 55+

Reliable connections 
at our lowest price 
Bundle two lines of unlimited wireless and home internet from AT&T for $99/mo., plus taxes and fees. Exclusively for customers 55+.
Price after discounts with eligible AutoPay and paperless bill. Taxes and fees extra. Prices vary depending on number of lines.
Call 833.625.1658
Combine your services and save even more
Choose your wireless lines

Get two unlimited lines with our AT&T 55+ plan.

Price after discounts with eligible AutoPay and paperless bill. Taxes and fees extra. Prices vary depending on number of lines.
Add home internet

Bundle with AT&T Fiber or AT&T Internet Air and save. Availability varies by location.

Price after discounts with eligible AutoPay and paperless bill. Taxes and fees extra. Prices vary depending on number of lines. *Req’s an active AT&T Fiber plan, BGW320 or BGW620 residential gateway and an eligible active unlimited postpaid AT&T Wireless plan. Backup service will not work during power outages. Account holder and authorized wireless user must activate Internet Backup feature via the Smart Home Manager app. AT&T may temporarily slow data speeds if the network is busy.
Enjoy your bundle

Stay connected both at home and on the go.

Proof of eligibility required.
Call 833.625.1658

Everything you need to stay connected for $99/mo.
Get two lines of unlimited wireless
Includes unlimited talk, text, and data in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, plus 10GB hotspot data per line and standard-definition streaming.

AT&T may temporarily slow data speeds if the network is busy.

Protection and backup included
Internet service includes AT&T ActiveArmor®. Fiber customers may also get AT&T Internet Backup, so you’ll always stay connected.
Stay connected with home internet
Where available, add AT&T Fiber 300Mbps or AT&T Internet Air with unlimited data and no equipment fees.
No annual contract
Enjoy the flexibility to adjust your service without long-term commitments.
